recommendation: Keep the core source fix. If future work changes the allowed contexts of the variable extension itself, make that change in the FHIR Extension Pack; no additional core change is needed for FHIR-24622.
issue_request: FHIR-24622 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It requested allowing the variable extension to be used with ActivityDefinition, PlanDefinition, and RequestGroup, with the same semantics as Questionnaire, and asked that usage be discussed in the PlanDefinition and ActivityDefinition realization topics.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#2288, implemented by commit 47eab681fc556b8bcd18e8d3555145dd24b79a6d, updated the then-active general extensions spreadsheet to allow the variable extension on PlanDefinition, RequestOrchestration, ActivityDefinition, and Measure-related contexts. That application did not add the requested PlanDefinition or ActivityDefinition realization prose. Later commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed extension definitions from the R5 core source as part of the move to the FHIR Extension Pack.
additional_context: The current core source still builds ActivityDefinition, PlanDefinition, and RequestOrchestration as active resources, but the variable StructureDefinition is maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack. The current Extension Pack source includes contexts for PlanDefinition, PlanDefinition.action, ActivityDefinition, RequestOrchestration, and version-scoped RequestGroup/RequestGroup.action. Zulip and Confluence searches did not find any relevant contrary discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/plandefinition/plandefinition-notes.xml and source/activitydefinition/activitydefinition-notes.xml to state that FHIRPath expressions can use named variables declared with the variable extension and that these variables have Questionnaire-style scope to descendant expressions and extensions on the same element. No core extension-definition source was changed because the artifact is now external to this checkout and already has the relevant contexts.
source_changes: source/plandefinition/plandefinition-notes.xml: added realization-topic guidance for using the variable extension on PlanDefinition or PlanDefinition.action in condition and dynamicValue FHIRPath expressions.
source/activitydefinition/activitydefinition-notes.xml: added realization-topic guidance for using the variable extension on ActivityDefinition in dynamicValue FHIRPath expressions.
